rationale: Price has just printed a fresh session low at $10.98, breaking the tight 11.01–11.03 compression that was the core of the entry thesis and eliminating the “no fresh lows” evidence of exhaustion. The tape is now below both the 9-EMA and VWAP while SPY remains weak and VIXY is bid, mechanically consistent with continued supply rather than mean-reversion. Closing removes the long before it reaches the $10.94 invalidation and frees capital.
